title: SOUTHWEST AIRLINES INVITES BUSY AMERICANS TO ENTER AIRPLANE MODE AND RECLAIM THEIR TIME
summary: Southwest is turning constant pings and burnout into over 185 million reasons to take a vacation DALLAS, Oct. 5,…...
body_markdown:
*Southwest is turning constant pings and burnout into over 185 million reasons to take a vacation*


DALLAS


, Oct. 5, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Southwest Airlines Co.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789181-1&h=1371254847&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.southwest.com%2F%3Fsrc%3DPRPRPRNmodeairplane261005&a=Southwest+Airlines+Co.) **(NYSE: LUV)** announces a new brand campaign today called "Enter Airplane Mode" inviting travelers to escape the daily grind as constant pings, packed calendars, and always-on routines continue to fuel real burnout. In a Southwest®-sponsored survey¹, 76% of respondents said they are experiencing burnout and 68% of respondents believe a trip is one way they can regain control of their time. With flexible policies including no change² or cancel fees³, an expansive domestic network⁴, and the best Crew in the sky⁵, Southwest has stepped in to turn daily distractions into vacations.


"As the airline that democratized the skies, Southwest Airlines® has always helped make the dream trip a reality and our new campaign, 'Enter Airplane Mode,' encourages Customers to recognize when they're approaching a breaking point and to turn that moment into their booking point," said[Sabrina Callahan](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789181-1&h=3331683965&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.swamedia.com%2Fabout-southwest%2Four-leadership%2Fsabrina-callahan-MCC6JW6KVG4FCHFM3MRLYNQUEPWY&a=Sabrina+Callahan) , Senior Vice President and Chief Digital & Marketing Officer. "With a Customer extension called 'Notification Vacation' we are taking it one step further from simply encouraging you to take the trip to helping you bring it to fruition."


[Notification Vacation](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789181-1&h=1820876747&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.notificationvacation.com%2F&a=Notification+Vacation) offers an opportunity for Customers to set aside the burnout and finally take the trip. With an interactive online activation that converts notifications into Rapid Rewards® points, Customers can upload a screenshot of their homepage notifications and receive Rapid Rewards points.⁶ It is an easy way to turn constant pings into a positive, reminding busy Americans that the reset they need may be closer than they think. Customers can also take a[Burnout Quiz](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789181-1&h=3557481327&u=https%3A%2F%2Fairplanemode.southwest.com%2F&a=Burnout+Quiz) ⁷ to understand their level of burnout and find inspiration for their next relaxing getaway. Together,[Notification Vacation](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789181-1&h=1820876747&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.notificationvacation.com%2F&a=Notification+Vacation) and the[Burnout Quiz](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789181-1&h=3557481327&u=https%3A%2F%2Fairplanemode.southwest.com%2F&a=Burnout+Quiz) offer Customers the chance to receive more than 185 million Rapid Rewards points total, with limits applying per Rapid Rewards Member.⁸


The "[Enter Airplane Mode](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789181-1&h=4079560561&u=https%3A%2F%2Fyoutube.com%2Fplaylist%3Flist%3DPLfJsJsmrG1Qw%26si%3Dz360uSROba1Am_KC&a=Enter+Airplane+Mode) " campaign spots were shot by Hollywood directors Will Speck and Josh Gordon and voiced by Adam Scott, whose recent role in a workplace-centered series adds a culturally relevant wink to the message about disconnecting from work and reconnecting with life beyond it. Created with ad agency GSD&M, the campaign begins airing today and brings "[Enter Airplane Mode](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789181-1&h=4079560561&u=https%3A%2F%2Fyoutube.com%2Fplaylist%3Flist%3DPLfJsJsmrG1Qw%26si%3Dz360uSROba1Am_KC&a=Enter+Airplane+Mode) " to life through relatable moments of everyday stressors, from overloaded calendars to endless meetings and packed commutes. Southwest is also working with creator agency, Later, and media agency, Spark Foundry, to bring the campaign to life as part of a full 360-degree effort.


Southwest continues to make getting away easier with purposeful, feedback-driven enhancements—from updated boarding and assigned seating to onboard investments such as free WiFi for Rapid Rewards® Members thanks to T-Mobile®⁹ and Starlink's fastest WiFi in the sky. Together with its flexible policies, expansive domestic network, and Hospitality that defines the brand, Southwest is making it easier for Customers to disconnect and enter airplane mode.

**ABOUT SOUTHWEST AIRLINES CO.**


[Southwest Airlines Co.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789181-1&h=1287311786&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.southwest.com%2F%3Fsrc%3DPRPRPRNmodeairplane261005&a=Southwest+Airlines+Co.%C2%A0) operates one of the world's most admired and awarded airlines, offering its one-of-a-kind value and Hospitality at 120 airports across 12 countries. Southwest took flight in 1971 to democratize the sky through friendly, reliable, and low-cost air travel and now carries more air travelers flying nonstop within the United States than any other airline⁴. By empowering its more than 73,000¹⁰ People to deliver unparalleled Hospitality, the maverick airline cherishes a passionate loyalty among more than 134 million Customers carried in 2025. Southwest leverages a unique legacy and mission to serve communities around the world including harnessing the power of its People and Purpose to put communities at the Heart of its success.
